node.statement: Zero-order expansion with no hidden big-O term. Put A=P+H, so ||A||<4delta and A+A^dagger=2H. Bilinearity gives 2F(P,H)=V^dagger bold-dot V-J+V^dagger bold-dot(V bold-dot A)+(A^dagger bold-dot V^dagger) bold-dot V+(A^dagger bold-dot V^dagger) bold-dot(V bold-dot A). Reassociate only the two linear terms and write V^dagger bold-dot V=J+q; then 2F=q+2H+R, where R=q bold-dot A+A^dagger bold-dot q+r_1+r_2+(A^dagger bold-dot V^dagger) bold-dot(V bold-dot A), ||r_1||,||r_2||<=e||V||^2||A||. Using ||q||<=2delta, ||V||<=1+2s from node 1.1.1, the product bound, s<=1/512, and ||A||<4delta gives ||R||<=128*(e*delta+delta^2). Hence ||F(P,H)-(q/2+H)||<=64*(e*delta+delta^2).
